referenceCypher.pack_lookup: MATCH (cr:CR {tdocNumber: $anchor}) MATCH (cr)-[:BELONGS_TO_CR_PACK]->(p:CRPack) RETURN DISTINCT p.crPackId, p.tsgMeeting
referenceCypher.disposition_pack: MATCH (cr:CR {tdocNumber: $anchor}) MATCH (cr)<-[:DISPOSITION_TARGET]-(d:DecisionDisposition {evidenceStatus: 'source_verified'}) -[:DISPOSITION_OF]->(:Resolution)-[:MADE_AT]->(m:Meeting) WHERE d.assessmentMethod CONTAINS '"scope": "whole_target"' MATCH (cr)-[:BELONGS_TO_CR_PACK]->(p:CRPack) RETURN DISTINCT d.dispositionCode, m.meetingNumber, p.crPackId, p.tsgMeeting
referenceCypher.full_chain: MATCH (cr:CR {tdocNumber: $anchor}) MATCH (cr)<-[:DISPOSITION_TARGET]-(d:DecisionDisposition {evidenceStatus: 'source_verified'}) -[:DISPOSITION_OF]->(:Resolution)-[:MADE_AT]->(m:Meeting) WHERE d.assessmentMethod CONTAINS '"scope": "whole_target"' MATCH (cr)-[:BELONGS_TO_CR_PACK]->(p:CRPack) MATCH (cr)-[:MODIFIES_SECTION]->(s:Section) RETURN DISTINCT d.dispositionCode, m.meetingNumber, p.crPackId, p.tsgMeeting, s.sectionNumber
referenceCypher.revision_chain: MATCH (:CR {tdocNumber: $anchor})<-[:IS_REVISION_OF*1..]-(cr) MATCH (cr)<-[:DISPOSITION_TARGET]-(d:DecisionDisposition {evidenceStatus: 'source_verified'}) -[:DISPOSITION_OF]->(:Resolution)-[:MADE_AT]->(m:Meeting) WHERE d.assessmentMethod CONTAINS '"scope": "whole_target"' MATCH (cr)-[:BELONGS_TO_CR_PACK]->(p:CRPack) RETURN DISTINCT cr.tdocNumber, d.dispositionCode, p.crPackId
referenceCypher.clause_history: MATCH (:Section {sectionId: $anchor})<-[:MODIFIES_SECTION]-(cr) MATCH (cr)-[:TARGET_RELEASE]->(release:Release) WHERE $anchor CONTAINS ('-' + release.releaseName + '-') MATCH (cr)<-[:DISPOSITION_TARGET]-(d:DecisionDisposition {evidenceStatus: 'source_verified'}) -[:DISPOSITION_OF]->(:Resolution)-[:MADE_AT]->(m:Meeting) WHERE d.assessmentMethod CONTAINS '"scope": "whole_target"' MATCH (cr)-[:BELONGS_TO_CR_PACK]->(p:CRPack) RETURN DISTINCT cr.tdocNumber, d.dispositionCode, m.meetingNumber, p.crPackId
referenceCypher.pack_origin: MATCH (:CRPack {crPackId: $anchor})-[:HAS_CR]->(cr) MATCH (cr)<-[:DISPOSITION_TARGET]-(d:DecisionDisposition {evidenceStatus: 'source_verified'}) -[:DISPOSITION_OF]->(:Resolution)-[:MADE_AT]->(m:Meeting) WHERE d.assessmentMethod CONTAINS '"scope": "whole_target"' RETURN DISTINCT cr.tdocNumber, d.dispositionCode, m.meetingNumber
referenceCypher.pack_lookup_empty: MATCH (cr:CR {tdocNumber: $anchor}) MATCH (cr)-[:BELONGS_TO_CR_PACK]->(p:CRPack) RETURN DISTINCT p.crPackId, p.tsgMeeting
referenceCypher.clause_neighbours: MATCH (x:CR {tdocNumber: $anchor})-[:TARGET_RELEASE]->(release:Release) MATCH (x)-[:MODIFIES_SECTION]->(s:Section) WHERE s.sectionId CONTAINS ('-' + release.releaseName + '-') MATCH (s)<-[:MODIFIES_SECTION]-(cr)-[:TARGET_RELEASE]->(other:Release) WHERE cr <> x AND other.releaseName = release.releaseName MATCH (cr)<-[:DISPOSITION_TARGET]-(d:DecisionDisposition {evidenceStatus: 'source_verified'}) -[:DISPOSITION_OF]->(:Resolution)-[:MADE_AT]->(m:Meeting) WHERE d.assessmentMethod CONTAINS '"scope": "whole_target"' MATCH (cr)-[:BELONGS_TO_CR_PACK]->(p:CRPack) RETURN DISTINCT s.sectionNumber, cr.tdocNumber, d.dispositionCode, m.meetingNumber, p.crPackId
referenceCypher.first_change: MATCH (p:CRPack {crPackId: $anchor})-[:HAS_CR]->(cr) MATCH (cr)<-[:DISPOSITION_TARGET]-(d:DecisionDisposition {evidenceStatus: 'source_verified'}) -[:DISPOSITION_OF]->(:Resolution)-[:MADE_AT]->(m:Meeting) WHERE d.assessmentMethod CONTAINS '"scope": "whole_target"' MATCH (cr)-[:TARGET_RELEASE]->(release:Release) MATCH (cr)-[:MODIFIES_SECTION]->(s:Section) WHERE s.sectionId CONTAINS ('-' + release.releaseName + '-') WITH DISTINCT p, cr, s, release WHERE NOT EXISTS { MATCH (s)<-[:MODIFIES_SECTION]-(e)-[:TARGET_RELEASE]->(er:Release) MATCH (e)-[:BELONGS_TO_CR_PACK]->(ep:CRPack) WHERE er.releaseName = release.releaseName AND toInteger(substring(ep.tsgMeeting, 4)) < toInteger(substring(p.tsgMeeting, 4)) } RETURN DISTINCT cr.tdocNumber, s.specNumber, s.sectionNumber
referenceCypher.previous_pack: MATCH (p:CRPack {crPackId: $anchor})-[:HAS_CR]->(cr) MATCH (cr)<-[:DISPOSITION_TARGET]-(d:DecisionDisposition {evidenceStatus: 'source_verified'}) -[:DISPOSITION_OF]->(:Resolution)-[:MADE_AT]->(m:Meeting) WHERE d.assessmentMethod CONTAINS '"scope": "whole_target"' MATCH (cr)-[:TARGET_RELEASE]->(release:Release) MATCH (cr)-[:MODIFIES_SECTION]->(s:Section) WHERE s.sectionId CONTAINS ('-' + release.releaseName + '-') WITH DISTINCT p, s, release MATCH (s)<-[:MODIFIES_SECTION]-(e)-[:TARGET_RELEASE]->(er:Release) WHERE er.releaseName = release.releaseName MATCH (e)-[:BELONGS_TO_CR_PACK]->(ep:CRPack) WHERE toInteger(substring(ep.tsgMeeting, 4)) < toInteger(substring(p.tsgMeeting, 4)) WITH s, max(toInteger(substring(ep.tsgMeeting, 4))) AS latest, collect(DISTINCT ep) AS earlier UNWIND earlier AS ep WITH s, ep, latest WHERE toInteger(substring(ep.tsgMeeting, 4)) = latest RETURN DISTINCT s.specNumber, s.sectionNumber, ep.crPackId, ep.tsgMeeting
